topic: Suyak to‘qimasida reaktiv (funksional) o‘zgarishlar. Suyak shakllanishi bosqichlari

slides.title: Kirish: mavzuning dolzarbligi

bullets.text: 2019-yilda dunyoda 178 mln dan ortiq yangi va 455 mln mavjud suyak sinishi holati qayd etilgan.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: Sinishlarning taxminan 5–10 foizida, ayniqsa uzun naysimon suyaklarda, bitish kechikadi yoki yolg‘on bo‘g‘im (nonunion) rivojlanadi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: Bunday holat takroriy operatsiya, uzoq reabilitatsiya va mehnat qobiliyati yo‘qolishi orqali katta iqtisodiy yuk keltiradi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: Ko‘pchilik sinish 6–8 haftada bitadi, lekin sezilarli qismi bitmaydi. Kechikish va yolg‘on bo‘g‘im xarajat va asoratni oshiradi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daqiqa. Muhokama: 1) Nima uchun sinish yuki kelajakda ortishi kutilmoqda? 2) Kechikkan bitish va yolg‘on bo‘g‘imning ijtimoiy oqibatlari qanday? Doskada: ikki ustunli ro‘yxat chizing, chapda «sinishlar soni», o‘ngda «bitmaydigan 5–10%». Tipik xato: talabalar 5–10% ni barcha sinishlarga emas, faqat kechikkan bitish va nonunion ulushiga tegishli deb bilmaydi.

slides.title: Darsning maqsadi va reja

bullets.text: Maqsad: sinishga javoban suyak to‘qimasida kechadigan reaktiv o‘zgarishlar va bitish bosqichlarini tushunish.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: Reja 1: yallig‘lanish, kallus hosil bo‘lishi va qayta qurilish bosqichlari hamda ularda ishtirok etuvchi hujayralar.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: Reja 2: periost, suyak ko‘migi va mushakdan keluvchi ildiz hujayralar hamda asosiy signal yo‘llari.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

bullets.text: Reja 3: bitishni buzuvchi omillar (yosh, diabet, chekish, infeksiya) va davolash yondashuvlari, jumladan paratiroid gormoni (PTH).

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 3 daqiqa. Muhokama: 1) Talabalar sinish bitishini qanday bosqichlarda tasavvur qiladi? 2) Qaysi omillar bitishni sekinlashtirishi mumkin? Doskada: dars rejasini 4 ta blokli gorizontal strelka sifatida chizing. Tipik xato: talabalar davolash usullarini bosqichlarni bilmay turib yodlashga urinadi, shuning uchun avval bosqichlar, keyin davo o‘rganilishini ta’kidlang.

slides.title: Reaktiv (funksional) o‘zgarish nima?

bullets.text: Sinish jarohatiga suyak to‘qimasi muvofiqlashgan regenerativ jarayon bilan javob beradi. Bu dars mavzusidagi reaktiv o‘zgarishlarning mohiyatidir.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: Jarayon immun, qon tomir, nerv va skelet signal dasturlarining vaqt va joy bo‘yicha aniq muvofiqlashuviga bog‘liq.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: Klassik bosqichlar: yallig‘lanish, kallus hosil bo‘lishi va qayta qurilish. Oxirida vaqtinchalik to‘qima plastinkasimon (lamellar) suyakka aylanadi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: Diqqat: doimiy yallig‘lanish, qon ta’minoti yetishmasligi, infeksiya yoki beqarorlik jarayonni kechikkan bitish yoki yolg‘on bo‘g‘imga olib keladi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daqiqa. Muhokama: 1) Nima uchun bitish faqat suyak hujayralariga bog‘liq emas? 2) Qaysi buzilish omillarini mahalliy va qaysilarini umumiy deb ajratasiz? Doskada: markazda «sinish», atrofida to‘rt strelka (immun, qon tomir, nerv, skelet). Tipik xato: bitishni faqat suyak hosil bo‘lishi deb tushunish. Eslatma: «reaktiv (funksional) o‘zgarish» atamasi manbada aynan uchramaydi, u dars mavzusi sifatida talqin qilingan.

slides.title: Sinish epidemiologiyasi va klinik muammo

bullets.text: AQShda yiliga taxminan 2 million sinish qayd etiladi: deyarli yarim million kasalxonaga yotqizish, 2,5 million shifokor qabuli va 180 000 hamshiralik uyiga yotqizish.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

bullets.text: Son suyagi sinishi barcha sinishlarning atigi 14% ini tashkil qiladi, biroq xarajat va kasallanishning asosiy qismi shunga to‘g‘ri keladi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

bullets.text: Son sinishi bir holat uchun taxminan 35 000–54 000 dollar turadi, bir yil ichida o‘lim ko‘rsatkichi 20–30% ga yetadi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

bullets.text: Ko‘pchilik sinish 6–8 haftada bitadi, ammo sezilarli ulushi bitmaydi. Kechikish va nonunion (bitmaslik) xarajat va kasallanishni oshiradi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama: nega son suyagi sinishi kam uchrasa ham xarajatning katta qismini beradi? Nega sinish yuki keksalar sonining oshishi bilan ortishi kutiladi? Doskaga: sinishning uchta oqibati (xarajat, kasallanish, o‘lim) ustunlarini chizdiring. Tipik xato: son sinishining ulushi (14%) bilan uning xarajat ulushini aralashtirish. Raqamlar AQSh ma‘lumoti ekanini ta‘kidlang.

slides.title: Tezkor savol: sinish yuki

bullets.text: Savol: uzun suyak sinishlarining taxminan necha foizi kechikib bitadi yoki nonunionga o‘tadi? Javob: taxminan 5–10%.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: Bitishni yomonlashtiradigan tizimli omillar: diabet, surunkali buyrak kasalligi, semizlik, chekish va jinsiy gormonlar tanqisligi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: Kechikkan bitish odatda taxminan 3–6 oydan keyin, nonunion taxminan 6–9 oydan keyin tashxislanadi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: Diqqat: xato qilish xavfi. Kechikkan bitish ≠ nonunion: birinchisida kallusda biologik faollik ko‘pincha davom etadi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 3 daq. Avval savolni o‘qing, talabalar javob variantlarini ovoz bilan tanlasin, keyin javobni oching. Muhokama: diabet va chekish bitishga qanday ta‘sir qilishi mumkin? Nega muammo kam resursli sharoitda og‘irlashadi? Doskaga: delayed union va nonunion uchun vaqt o‘qini (3–6 va 6–9 oy) chizdiring. Tipik xato: ikkala atamani sinonim deb o‘ylash.

slides.title: Bitishning klassik uch bosqichi

bullets.text: Klassik sxema: yallig‘lanish, kallus hosil bo‘lishi va remodellanish bosqichlari.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: Bosqichlar bir-birini qoplaydi: keyingisi oldingisi tugamasdan boshlanadi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

bullets.text: Remodellanish – oxirgi va eng uzoq bosqich, vaqtinchalik suyak yetuk lamellar suyakka almashadi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

diagram.caption: Uch bosqich qisqacha
rows: Yumshoq, so‘ng qattiq kallus hosil bo‘lishi

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 7 daq. Muhokama: nega bosqichlar qat‘iy ajratilmagan, qoplanishi nimani anglatadi? Nega remodellanish eng uzun? Doskaga: uch bosqichni qoplanuvchi uchta strelka sifatida chizdiring. Qo‘shimcha: Bikle to‘rt bosqichli tasnifni beradi (kallus ikkiga bo‘linadi), bu klassik uch bosqichga zid emas. Tipik xato: bosqichlarni qat‘iy ketma-ket va bir-biridan ajralgan deb o‘ylash.

slides.title: Bikle bo‘yicha to‘rt faza

bullets.text: Gematomada trombotsit, neytrofil va monotsitlar bo‘ladi; M1 makrofaglar yallig‘lanishni boshlaydi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

bullets.text: 2-fazada angiogenez, xondrogenez va osteogenez boshlanadi, yumshoq kallus hosil bo‘ladi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

bullets.text: 3-fazada xondrotsitlar mineralizatsiyalanadi; 4-fazada to‘qima lamellyar suyakka aylanadi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: nega yallig‘lanishsiz ildiz hujayralar faollashmaydi? Yallig‘lanish bosqichi bitishda qanday rol o‘ynaydi? Doskada to‘rt fazani o‘qlar bilan chizdiring va har fazaga bitta asosiy hujayra yozing. Tipik xato: fazalarni qat’iy ajratilgan deb o‘ylash, aslida ular bir-biriga o‘tadi.

slides.title: Fazalarning davomiyligi

bullets.text: Fazalar bir-biriga o‘tadi: ularning chegarasi aniq emas, jarayonlar qisman bir vaqtda kechadi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

bullets.text: Yosh, qandli diabet, semizlik va autoimmun kasalliklar bitishga ta’sir qilib, nobitish xavfini oshiradi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

bullets.text: Remodellanish 3–4 haftadan keyin boshlanib, oylar davomida davom etadi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama: nima uchun 4-faza eng uzun? Qaysi kasalliklar vaqtni cho‘zadi? Doskada vaqt chizig‘ini chizib, fazalarning ustma-ust tushishini ko‘rsating. Tipik xato: 5 kunlik muddatni barcha fazalarga tatbiq qilish. Tezkor savol: qaysi faza oylar-yillar davom etadi?

slides.title: Uchta suyak hosil bo‘lish joyi

bullets.text: Sayt 1 va 2 hujayralarining asosiy manbai periost ildiz hujayralaridir.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

bullets.text: Sayt 3 hujayralari ilik ildiz hujayralaridan va kortikal osteotsitlarning transdifferensiyasidan keladi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

bullets.text: Diqqat: ilik ichidagi pin sayt 3 ni yo‘q qiladi, shuning uchun u kam o‘rganilgan.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: nima uchun sayt 2 o‘sish plastinkasidagi suyak hosil bo‘lishiga o‘xshaydi? Pin qo‘yilsa sayt 3 ga nima bo‘ladi? Doskada uzun suyak sinishini chizib, uch joyni raqamlang. Tipik xato: xaftaga bosqichi barcha joylarda bor deb o‘ylash, aslida u faqat sayt 2 da bor.

slides.title: Diqqat: intramembranoz ≠ endoxondral

bullets.text: Intramembranoz suyak hosil bo‘lishi periost yuzasi bo‘ylab kechadi va oraliq xaftaga bosqichini talab qilmaydi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

bullets.text: Endoxondral suyak sinish uchlari orasidagi ko‘prik joyda rivojlanadi: avval xaftaga hosil bo‘ladi, keyin u suyak bilan almashadi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

bullets.text: Intramedullyar suyak ilik ichida, sinish uchlarida hosil bo‘ladi. U ham xaftaga oraliq bosqichisiz kechadi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

bullets.text: Diqqat: xato qilish xavfi. Xaftagasiz suyak hosil bo‘lishini faqat intramembranoz deb o‘ylamang; intramedullyar yo‘l ham xaftagasiz.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 4 daq. Muhokama: 1) Uchala saytning farqi nimada, xaftaga qaysi birida bor? 2) Nega endoxondral jarayon suyakning dastlabki rivojlanishiga o‘xshaydi? Doskada chizing: uzun suyak sinishining sxemasi va unda 1-, 2-, 3-saytlarni belgilang, xaftagali yo‘lni alohida rangda ko‘rsating. Tipik xato: talabalar intramedullyar suyakni ham xaftaga orqali hosil bo‘ladi deb o‘ylaydi.

slides.title: Voqea tahlili: intramedullyar mix

bullets.text: Vaziyat: uzun suyak sinishi intramedullyar mix bilan mahkamlangan. Mix ilik bo‘shlig‘ini egallab, uni amalda yo‘qotadi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

bullets.text: Ilik bo‘shlig‘i yo‘qolsa, 3-sayt (ilik ichidagi) yangi suyak hosil bo‘lishi uchun joy qolmaydi. Shu sababli bu sayt ko‘pincha e’tibordan chetda qolgan.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

bullets.text: Sichqonlarda intramedullyar suyak 5–10-kunda boshlanadi, vaqtinchalik bo‘ladi va taxminan 28-kunga kelib deyarli yo‘qoladi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

bullets.text: Savol: mix qo‘yilgan sinishda qaysi saytlarda suyak hosil bo‘lishi saqlanadi, qaysi birida to‘sqinlik qilinadi? Javobni asoslang.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama: 1) Mix 3-saytga qanday ta’sir qiladi? 2) 1- va 2-sayt (periost, ko‘prik) mix qo‘yilganda ham ishlaydimi? Doskada chizing: mix kiritilgan suyak kesimi, ilik bo‘shlig‘i va 3 saytni belgilang. Tipik xato: mix butun suyak tiklanishini to‘xtatadi deb o‘ylash; manbada faqat 3-sayt haqida gap ketadi. Sichqon ma’lumotini odamga to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri ko‘chirmang.

slides.title: 1-faza: gematoma va trombotsitlar

bullets.text: Sinishda qon tomirlari uziladi va gematoma hosil bo‘ladi. U vaqtinchalik matritsa sifatida tiklanishni boshlab beradi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: Trombotsitlar tez agregatsiyalanib qon ketishini to‘xtatadi va o‘sish omillari hamda sitokinlarni ajratib chiqaradi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: Bu moddalar yallig‘lanish hujayralarini va mezenximal stromal hujayralarni (MSC) sinish joyiga jalb qiladi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: Gematomani eritrotsitlar va trombotsitlar hosil qiladi, unga ilikdan neytrofil va monotsitlar kiradi. Bu faza taxminan 5 kun davom etadi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama: 1) Gematoma nima uchun tiklanishning boshlanishi hisoblanadi? 2) Trombotsitlar qon to‘xtatishdan tashqari qanday vazifa bajaradi? Doskada chizing: gematoma ichidagi hujayralar (trombotsit, eritrotsit, neytrofil, monotsit) va MSC jalb qilinishini ko‘rsatuvchi strelkalar. Tipik xato: gematomani faqat qon laxtasi deb hisoblash; u signal va hujayralarni jalb qilish markazi ham.

slides.title: 1-faza: neytrofil va makrofaglar

bullets.text: Gematoma hosil bo‘lgach, neytrofillar bir necha soat ichida jarohat joyiga kiradi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: Monositlar gematomaga kirib, makrofagga aylanadi va faollik holatini o‘zgartiradi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: Erta M1 makrofaglar gipoksik gematomada yallig‘lanish sitokinlarini ajratadi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega neytrofillar birinchi kiradi? 2) Gematoma nima uchun gipoksik va qon tomirsiz? Doskada chizish: gematomadan M2 gacha 5 bosqichli zanjirni chizing. Tipik xato: talabalar M1 ni faqat zararli deb o‘ylaydi, aslida u tozalash va himoya uchun kerak.

slides.title: Eslab qoling: M1 → M2 o‘tishi

bullets.text: Eslab qoling: M1 – “tozalovchi va qo‘riqchi”, M2 – “quruvchi va tinchlantiruvchi”. Bu qisqa mnemonika manbadagi funksiyalarga asoslangan.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: Erta M1 makrofaglar to‘qimani tozalaydi va mikroblardan himoya qiladi. Keyingi M2 makrofaglar yallig‘lanishni so‘ndiradi, angiogenez va progenitorlar differensiatsiyasini qo‘llaydi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: M2 makrofaglar interleykin-10 (IL-10) ajratib yallig‘lanishni kamaytiradi, VEGF (qon tomir o‘sish omili) orqali tomir hosil bo‘lishini qo‘llaydi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

bullets.text: Diqqat: M1 ≠ M2 qat’iy ikki alohida guruh emas. M1/M2 soddalashtirilgan sxema bo‘lib, funksional o‘tishni ifodalovchi qulay qisqartma sifatida ishlatiladi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 4 daq. Tezkor savol: “Qaysi makrofag angiogenezni qo‘llaydi?” Muhokama: M1/M2 sxemasi nega soddalashtirilgan hisoblanadi? Doskada ikki ustunli ro‘yxat yozdiring: M1 vazifalari va M2 vazifalari. Tipik xato: M1 va M2 ni doimiy, o‘zgarmas hujayra turlari deb tushunish.

slides.title: Boshqa immun hujayralar

bullets.text: Regulyator T hujayralar (Treg) haddan tashqari yallig‘lanishni jilovlaydi va tiklanishni qo‘llovchi immun holatni saqlaydi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: Semiz hujayralar qon tomir o‘tkazuvchanligiga, leykotsitlar jalb etilishiga va mahalliy immun faollikka ta’sir qilishi mumkin.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: Mezenximal o‘zak hujayralar (MSC) ham yallig‘lanishni bostiradi: to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri kontakt va TGFβ (transformatsiyalovchi o‘sish omili beta) orqali Treg ni induksiya qiladi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

bullets.text: Dendritik va B hujayralar adaptiv immun javobni hamda osteoklastlar bilan bog‘liq qayta qurilishni modulyatsiya qilishi mumkin.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

Doskada chizish: gematoma markazida neytrofil, makrofag, Treg va semiz hujayra belgilarini joylashtiring. Tipik xato: immun hujayralarni faqat himoya vazifali deb bilish, ular tiklanishni ham boshqaradi.

bullets.text: Vaziyat (o‘quv misoli): sinish joyida infeksiya bor, yallig‘lanish so‘nmaydi va bitish tiklanish bosqichiga o‘tolmayapti.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: O‘sma nekrozi omili (TNF), interleykin-1β (IL-1β) va IL-6 uzoq saqlansa, yallig‘lanuvchi makrofaglar faol qoladi, osteogenez va angiogenez bosiladi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: Diqqat: rentgendagi kallus ko‘rinishi infeksiya borligini yoki bitish qobiliyatini o‘zi isbotlamaydi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.

bullets.text: Savol: nega sitokinlarni butunlay bostirish xavfli va davomli yallig‘lanish qanday oqibatga (bitmaslik) olib kelishi mumkin?

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6-7 daqiqa. Muhokama: 1) Yallig‘lanish nega dastlab kerak (chiqindini tozalash, mikroblarga qarshi himoya, progenitorlarni jalb qilish)? 2) Davomli TNF, IL-1β, IL-6 reparativ jarayonga qanday to‘sqinlik qiladi? Doskada chizish: yallig‘lanish → tiklanish o‘tishi va davomli yallig‘lanishda uning to‘xtashi strelkasi. Tipik xato: talabalar yallig‘lanishni faqat zararli deb o‘ylaydi; dastlabki yallig‘lanish bitish uchun zarur, zarar uning cho‘zilishida.

slides.title: 2-faza: yumshoq kallus va angiogenez

bullets.text: Periost progenitorlari osteoblast yoki xondrotsitga aylanib, kallus hosil qiladi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

bullets.text: Kislorodli, barqaror joyda osteoblast, gipoksiya yoki zo‘riqishda xondrotsit yo‘nalishi tanlanadi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: Yangi kapillyarlar kislorod va oziq yetkazib, yumshoq kallusdan qattiq kallusga o‘tishni ta’minlaydi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 7 daqiqa. Muhokama: 1) Nega angiogenez bo‘lmasa yumshoq kallus qattiq kallusga aylanmaydi? 2) Periost progenitorlari bilan ilik progenitorlarining roli qanday farqlanadi? Doskada chizish: sinish uchlari, ular orasida xaftagali ko‘prik va periost bo‘ylab suyak qatlami. Tipik xato: yumshoq kallusni suyak deb o‘ylash; u xaftagali, mineralizatsiyadan keyin qattiq kallusga aylanadi.

slides.title: Kallusda hujayra taqdirini belgilovchi omillar

bullets.text: Kislorod va barqarorlik bo‘lsa hujayralar osteoblastga, gipoksiyada xondrotsitga aylanadi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: Runx2 osteogenez dasturini, Sox9 esa xondrogenez dasturini boshqaradi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.

bullets.text: Gipertrofik xondrotsitlarning ayrimlari osteoblast zaxirasiga qo‘shilishi mumkin.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 7 daqiqa. Muhokama: 1) Fiksatsiya beqaror bo‘lsa, kallusda qaysi yo‘nalish ustun bo‘ladi? 2) Nega xondrotsitlar oxirgi hujayra emas deb hisoblanadi? Doskada chizish: MSC dan ikki shoxli sxema, bir shox Runx2 → osteoblast, ikkinchisi Sox9 → xondrotsit. Tipik xato: Runx2 va Sox9 ni aralashtirish; Runx2 suyak, Sox9 xaftaga dasturi.

slides.title: Tezkor savol: gipoksiya va kallus

bullets.text: Savol: sinish joyida mezenximal stromal hujayralar (MSC) qaysi sharoitda xaftaga hosil qiladi, qaysi sharoitda esa to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri suyak?

bullets.text: Kislorodga boy va mexanik barqaror joylarda MSC osteogen yo‘nalishda ketadi. Kortikal yuzada intramembranoz suyak hosil bo‘ladi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: Gipoksik yoki mexanik zo‘riqqan joyda MSC xondrogen dasturni tanlaydi. Natijada sinishni mustahkamlovchi xaftagali (yumshoq) kallus hosil bo‘ladi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: Diqqat: endoxondral ≠ intramembranoz. Intramembranoz va intramedulyar suyak xaftaga bosqichisiz hosil bo‘ladi, xaftaga esa ko‘prik hududida bo‘ladi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 4 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega xaftaga aynan gipoksik, zo‘riqqan joyda paydo bo‘ladi? 2) Intramembranoz suyak qayerda hosil bo‘ladi? Doskada: sinish chizig‘i va 3 hudud (periost yuzasi, ko‘prik, ilik) sxemasini chizing, har biriga ‘xaftagali / xaftagasiz’ deb yozing. Tipik xato: talabalar barcha suyak xaftaga orqali hosil bo‘ladi deb o‘ylaydi. Avval talabalarga javob berdiring, keyin slaydni oching.

slides.title: 3-faza: yumshoq kallusdan qattiq kallusga

bullets.text: 3-faza bir necha hafta davom etadi. Xaftaga olib tashlanib kalsiylanadi, qattiq kallus esa to‘liqroq shakllanadi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

bullets.text: Xondrotsitlar mineralizatsiyalanadi. Ularni osteoklastlar olib tashlaydi yoki ular osteoblastlarga aylanadi. Jarayon tomirlanish bilan birga boradi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

bullets.text: Gipertrofik xondrotsitlarda sox9 va X tur kollagen kamayadi, runx2 va β-katenin ortadi. So‘ng ishqoriy fosfataza, osterix, osteopontin va osteokalsin paydo bo‘ladi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

bullets.text: MMP13 (matriks metalloproteinaza-13) matriksni parchalaydi, noggin esa pasayishi kerak. Dastlab to‘qima suyagi (woven bone) hosil bo‘ladi, 4-fazada u plastinkali suyakka almashadi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Gipertrofik xondrotsitning ikki taqdiri qanday? 2) MMP13 nima uchun kerak? Qo‘shimcha: Staubli va boshq. ba’zi gipertrofik xondrotsitlar osteoblastlar zahirasiga qo‘shilishini yozadi, ya’ni ular oxirgi differensiallangan hujayra emas. Doskada: xondrotsit → gipertrofiya → mineralizatsiya → osteoklast bilan olib tashlanish yoki osteoblastga o‘tish zanjirini chizing. Tipik xato: 3-faza bilan 4-fazani aralashtirish. To‘qima suyagi 3-fazada hosil bo‘ladi, plastinkali suyakka almashishi 4-fazada bo‘ladi.

slides.title: Qon tomirlar: VEGF/HIF va osteoangiogenez

bullets.text: Gipoksiyada HIF-1α (gipoksiya bilan induksiyalanuvchi omil) barqarorlashadi va VEGFni yoqadi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: VEGF (tomir endoteliy o‘sish omili) VEGFR2 orqali endoteliy ko‘payishi va tomir hosil bo‘lishini beradi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: H tur tomirlar osteoprogenitorlar bilan bog‘liq; bu asosan tajriba modellarida aniqlangan.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nima uchun faqat tomir sonini oshirish yetarli emas? 2) Kislorod tiklangach HIF va VEGF nima bo‘ladi? Doskada: 5 tugunli zanjirni chizing va VEGFR1 ‘tuzoq’ vazifasini, VEGFR2 esa asosiy signal ekanini yozing. Tipik xato: VEGFR1 va VEGFR2 rolini aralashtirish. VEGFR2 asosiy angiogen effektni beradi, VEGFR1 esa VEGFni tutib turuvchi modulyator. Slaydda H tur tomirlar faqat tajribada o‘rganilganini ham eslating.

slides.title: 4-faza: remodellanish

bullets.text: Remodellanish — bitishning oxirgi va eng uzoq bosqichi. Vaqtinchalik to‘qima (woven) suyagi asta-sekin yetuk plastinkali suyakka almashadi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: Bu jarayon sinishdan 3–4 hafta o‘tgach boshlanadi va oylar davomida cho‘ziladi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

bullets.text: Maqsad — suyakni sinishdan oldingi holatiga qaytarish, shu jumladan qon yaratuvchi va trabekulyar tuzilmalarni tiklash.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

bullets.text: Odam suyagida vaqt o‘tishi bilan Havers tizimi, ya’ni markaziy qon kanali va kanalchalar tarmog‘i qayta hosil bo‘ladi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 4 daq. Muhokama savoli: nima uchun remodellanish eng uzoq bosqich hisoblanadi? Rentgenda bitish ko‘ringani suyak to‘liq tiklangan degani emasmi? Doskada chizing: to‘qima (woven) suyak → plastinkali suyak o‘qi va ustiga 3–4 haftadan oylargacha vaqt shkalasini yozing. Tipik xato: talabalar to‘qima suyagini plastinkali suyak bilan adashtiradi va remodellanishni bir necha kunlik jarayon deb o‘ylaydi.

slides.title: Remodellanish hujayralari

bullets.text: Rezorbsiya va hosil bo‘lish sikllari bir-biriga bog‘liq; suyak mexanik yuklamaga moslashadi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: Osteoklastlar — gematopoetik kelib chiqishli yirik ko‘p yadroli hujayralar.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: Osteotsitlar kanalchalar orqali zo‘riqish va mikrozararni sezib, boshqa hujayralar ishini yo‘naltiradi.

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama savoli: osteotsit nega mexanosensor deyiladi? Osteoklast faolligi juda erta so‘nsa nima bo‘lishi mumkin? Doskada chizing: rezorbsiya chuqurchasi → osteoblast → osteoid → plastinkali suyak ketma-ketligini. Tipik xato: osteotsitni faqat passiv hujayra deb hisoblash va qoplovchi hujayralar rolini unutish.

slides.title: RANKL/OPG o‘qi

bullets.text: RANKL ni osteoblastlar, osteotsitlar, stromal va T hujayralar ishlab chiqaradi. U osteoklast prekursorlaridagi RANK ga bog‘lanib osteoklastogenezni qo‘zg‘atadi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: OPG — tuzoq (decoy) retseptor: RANKL ni tutib qoladi va osteoklast hosil bo‘lishini cheklaydi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: RANKL/OPG nisbati almashinuvning sof yo‘nalishini belgilaydi. Unga Wnt/β-katenin, estrogen holati va yallig‘lanish sitokinlari ta’sir qiladi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: Diqqat: RANKL ≠ OPG. RANKL rezorbsiyani kuchaytiradi, OPG esa uni cheklaydi; muhimi ikkalasining nisbati.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 5 daq. Muhokama savoli: RANKL/OPG nisbati oshsa suyak almashinuvi qaysi tomonga siljiydi? Estrogen tanqisligi bu nisbatga qanday ta’sir qilishi mumkin? Doskada chizing: tarozi — bir pallada RANKL (rezorbsiya), ikkinchisida OPG (tutib qolish). Tipik xato: OPG ni osteoklastni qo‘zg‘atuvchi omil deb o‘ylash yoki faqat RANKL miqdoriga qarab xulosa chiqarish.

slides.title: Voqea tahlili: remodellanish va dori

bullets.text: Vaziyat: sinish kallusi remodellanish bosqichida. Shifokor osteoklastni bostiradigan standart dorini tanlamoqchi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: Remodellanishda osteoklast eski to‘qimani yemiradi, osteoblast esa yangi plastinkasimon suyak hosil qiladi. Bu ikki jarayon bir-biriga bog‘liq.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: Hayvon tadqiqotlarida PTH (paratireoid gormon) alendronat kabi antirezorbtivlardan ustun chiqdi. Klinik natijalar esa bir xil emas.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

bullets.text: Savol: osteoklastni bostirish nega kallusning pishgan suyakka aylanishiga xalaqit berishi mumkin?

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 6 daq. Muhokama: 1) Osteoklast faqat yemiruvchi hujayramikan? 2) PTH va alendronatning kallusga ta’siri qanday farq qiladi? Doskada: rezorbsiya → osteoblast chaqirilishi → plastinkasimon suyak zanjirini chizing. Tipik xato: osteoklastni bostirish har doim suyakni mustahkamlaydi, deb o‘ylash. Manbaga ko‘ra rezorbsiyani ham erta bostirish, ham haddan ortiq saqlash remodellanishga halal beradi.

slides.title: Skelet o‘zak/progenitor hujayralari manbalari

bullets.text: Periost o‘zak hujayralari uzun suyak tiklanishida asosiy manba hisoblanadi.

bullets.text: Katta yoshlilarda ilikdagi LepR+ hujayralar osteoblastlarning asosiy manbalaridan biri.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

bullets.text: Mushak ham hissa qo‘shadi, ammo Pax7 yo‘ldosh hujayralar ahamiyatsiz ko‘rinadi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 7 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega bitta o‘zak hujayra g‘oyasi shubha ostida? 2) Periost hujayralari ilik hujayralaridan nimasi bilan ustun? Doskada: sinish joyi atrofida periost, ilik va mushakni chizib, har biridan strelka qo‘ying. Tipik xato: Pax7 yo‘ldosh hujayralarni mushakdagi FAP hujayralari bilan adashtirish. Diqqat: FAP hujayralari hissa qo‘shadi, Pax7 yo‘ldosh hujayralar esa yo‘q.

slides.title: Asosiy signal yo‘llari

bullets.text: Signallar fazaga xos: bir yo‘l erta va kech bosqichda turlicha ta’sir qiladi.

bullets.text: Natija miqdor bilan emas, vaqt, retseptor turi va hujayra bilan belgilanadi.

bullets.text: Wnt muddatidan oldin haddan ortiq faollashsa, xaftaga oraliq bosqichini bostirishi mumkin.

slides.teacher_notes: Vaqt: 8 daq. Muhokama: 1) Nega TNFni butunlay bostirish zararli bo‘lishi mumkin? 2) Wnt vaqtida va vaqtidan oldin faollashsa nima farq qiladi? Doskada: vaqt o‘qida yallig‘lanish → xaftaga → qattiq kallus va har bir yo‘l maksimumini belgilang. Tipik xato: signal yo‘lini faqat ‘foydali’ yoki faqat ‘zararli’ deb baholash. Manbaga ko‘ra ta’sir kontekstga bog‘liq.

slides.title: Mexanik omillar va mexanotransduksiya

bullets.text: Barqarorsizlik, yukdan himoyalanish (stress shielding) yoki uzoq yuk bo‘lmasligi kallus tuzilishi va bitishini buzadi.

source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

bullets.text: Osteotsitlar mexanosensor: lakuno-kanalikulyar tarmoq orqali zo‘riqish va suyuqlik siljishini sezib, osteoblast va osteoklast faolligini yo‘naltiradi.

bullets.text: Yuk bor joyda YAP/TAZ (mexanosezgir transkripsiya omillari) yadroga o‘tib osteogen genlarni yoqadi; yuk bo‘lmasa sitoplazmada qoladi.

Doskada chizing: yuk → integrin/FAK → YAP/TAZ yadroda → osteogen genlar; yuk yo‘q → YAP/TAZ sitoplazmada. Tipik xato: rentgenda bitish bor ekan, mexanik tiklanish ham to‘liq deb o‘ylash; manbada bu har doim shunday emasligi aytilgan.

bullets.text: Uzoq davom etsa yolg‘on bo‘g‘im (pseudarthrosis) hosil bo‘ladi: harakatchan tolali qatlam.

bullets.text: Omillar yallig‘lanish, qon tomir, hujayra jalb etilishi va qayta shakllanishning izchilligini buzadi.

source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

Doskada chizing: omil → mexanizm → oqibat zanjiri (masalan, diabet). Tipik xato: NSAID har doim bitishni buzadi deb aytish; manbada klinik dalillar aralash deyilgan.

bullets.text: Bunday nuqson oddiy rentgen tasvirda deyarli bilinmasligi mumkin. Uzoq muddatda u suyakning mexanik ishlashini yomonlashtirishi ehtimoli bor.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.

bullets.text: Diabetda ilg‘or glikatsiya mahsulotlari (AGE) retseptori faollashadi, oksidativ stress oshadi, qon tomir endotelial o‘sish omili (VEGF) kamayadi, mikrotomirlar zararlanadi.

Doskada chizish: PTH → retseptor → to‘rt yo‘l → bitishni rag‘batlantirish sxemasi. Tipik xato: davolash «bitmaslikni kamaytiradi» deb o‘ylash; manbada faqat bitish tezlashishi ko‘rsatilgan, bitmaslik soni kamaymagan.

bullets.text: Uzun suyakda yangi suyak 3 joyda hosil bo‘ladi: periost bo‘ylab (intramembranoz), sinish uchlari orasida (endoxondral) va ilik ichida (intramedullyar).

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.

Doskada chizing: 4 bosqich zanjiri va suyak kesimida 3 joyni belgilang. Tipik xato: intramembranoz va endoxondral suyak hosil bo‘lishini aralashtirish. Qo‘shimcha: teriparatid (PTH 1–34) sinish bitishini tezlashtirishi mumkin, lekin odamlarda tasdiqlanmagan.

mcq.question: Klinikada ko‘p sonli sinish bemorlari, jumladan uzun naysimon suyak sinishlari davolanmoqda. Zamonaviy yordamga qaramay, ularning qancha qismida bitishning kechikishi yoki bitmasligi (nonunion) kutiladi?
mcq.explanation: Mualliflar ko‘pchilik sinishlar zamonaviy davoda bitishini, taxminan 5–10 foizida esa (ayniqsa uzun naysimon suyaklarda) bitish kechikishi yoki nonunion rivojlanishini ko‘rsatadi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

mcq.question: Staubli va hamkasblari ko‘rsatgan klassik sinish bitishi bosqichlarining to‘g‘ri tartibi qaysi?
options: Kallus hosil bo‘lishi, yallig‘lanish, qayta shakllanish
Qayta shakllanish, yallig‘lanish, kallus hosil bo‘lishi
Yallig‘lanish, qayta shakllanish, kallus hosil bo‘lishi
Yallig‘lanish, kallus hosil bo‘lishi, qayta shakllanish
mcq.explanation: Klassik sxema yallig‘lanish, kallus hosil bo‘lishi va qayta shakllanishdan iborat. Qayta shakllanish oxirgi va eng uzoq bosqich bo‘lib, to‘qima to‘qilgan suyak plastinkasimon suyakka almashadi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

mcq.question: Sinishdan 2 kun o‘tgan bemorning sinish joyida eritrotsit va trombotsitlardan gematoma hosil bo‘lgan, unga neytrofil va monotsitlar kirgan. Bikle bo‘yicha bu qaysi faza?
mcq.explanation: 1-fazaga gematoma hosil bo‘lishi, unga neytrofil va monotsitlarning kirishi va yallig‘lanish javobi xos. Bu faza taxminan 5 kun davom etadi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

mcq.question: Talaba sinishdan 8 oy o‘tgan bemorda ham suyak qayta shakllanishi davom etayotganidan hayron. Bikle bo‘yicha qaysi faza va davomiylik buni tushuntiradi?
mcq.explanation: 4-faza (qayta shakllanish) oylardan hatto yillargacha davom etadi, fazalar esa bir-birini qoplaydi. Birinchi va ikkinchi fazalar taxminan 5 kundan, uchinchisi bir necha haftadan davom etadi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

mcq.question: Mualliflarning ma‘lumotiga ko‘ra, 2019-yilda dunyoda yangi sinish holatlari (incident cases) soni qancha bo‘lgan?
mcq.explanation: 2019-yilda 178 milliondan ortiq yangi sinish holati qayd etilgan. 455 million esa shu yilgi mavjud (prevalent) holatlar soni, ya‘ni ikki xil ko‘rsatkich.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

mcq.question: Uzun suyak singanda periost yuzasi bo‘ylab, sinish joyidan biroz nariroqda tog‘ay bosqichisiz suyak hosil bo‘lmoqda. Bu qaysi joy?
mcq.explanation: 1-joy periost yuzasi bo‘ylab joylashgan. Unda intramembranoz suyak hosil bo‘ladi va oraliq xondrotsit bosqichi kerak bo‘lmaydi. 2-joy (ko‘prik) endoxondral yo‘l bilan shakllanadi. 3-joy ilik ichida joylashgan.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

mcq.question: Gistologik tekshiruvda sinish uchlarini bog‘lovchi zonada suyak avval tog‘ay oraliq bosqichidan o‘tgani aniqlandi. Bu qaysi jarayon?
options: Ko‘prik zonasida endoxondral suyak hosil bo‘lishi
mcq.explanation: Sinish uchlarini bog‘lovchi 2-joyda suyak endoxondral yo‘l bilan shakllanadi va bu jarayon suyakning dastlabki rivojlanishini ko‘p jihatdan takrorlaydi. Intramembranoz va ilik ichi suyak hosil bo‘lishida tog‘ay oraliq bosqichi bo‘lmaydi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

mcq.question: Tadqiqotchi hayvon sinishini ilik kanaliga mix kiritib mahkamladi va ilik ichida yangi suyak hosil bo‘lmadi. Buning sababi nima?
options: Mix ilik bo‘shlig‘ini egallab, yangi suyak hosil bo‘lishiga to‘sqinlik qiladi
Mix periost ildiz hujayralarini butunlay nobud qilib yuboradi
Mix tog‘ay oraliq bosqichini majburan qo‘shib, jarayonni buzadi
Mix gematoma hosil bo‘lishini to‘liq to‘xtatib qo‘yadi
mcq.explanation: Ilik ichi suyak hosil bo‘lishi (3-joy) mix qo‘yilgan tadqiqotlarda e’tibordan chetda qolgan, chunki mix ilik bo‘shlig‘ini yo‘q qilib, yangi suyak hosil bo‘lishiga yo‘l qo‘ymaydi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

mcq.question: Sinish gematomasida trombotsitlar dastlabki yallig‘lanish bosqichida qanday asosiy vazifani bajaradi?
options: Gematomani suyuqlantirib, qon quyilmasini tezda so‘ndiradi
O‘sish omillari va sitokinlar ajratib, hujayralarni jalb qiladi
Yetuk lamellar suyak matriksini bevosita hosil qilib beradi
mcq.explanation: Trombotsitlar tez to‘planib gemostazni ta’minlaydi, o‘sish omillari va sitokinlar ajratadi. Bular yallig‘lanish hujayralarini va mezenximal stromal/o‘zak hujayralarni (MSC) sinish joyiga jalb qiladi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

mcq.question: Sinishning dastlabki yallig‘lanish davri o‘tib, gematomada IL-10 ajratuvchi makrofaglar ustun bo‘ldi. Bu makrofaglar qaysi fenotipga mansub?
mcq.explanation: Dastlabki M1 makrofaglar yallig‘lanishni qo‘llab-quvvatlaydi. Keyin M2 makrofaglar IL-10 ajratib yallig‘lanishni kamaytiradi, angiogenez va MSC differensiatsiyasini rag‘batlantiradi. M1/M2 sxemasi soddalashtirilgan, lekin foydali qisqa tushuncha.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

mcq.question: Uzun suyak sinishida sinish uchlari orasidagi ko‘prik zonasida avval tog‘aysimon, keyin mineralizatsiyalanayotgan to‘qima topildi. Bu zonada suyak qaysi yo‘l bilan hosil bo‘lmoqda?
options: Intramembranoz yo‘l bilan, tog‘ay oraliq bosqichisiz
Endoxondral yo‘l bilan, tog‘ay oraliq bosqichi orqali
Intramedullyar yo‘l bilan, ilik bo‘shlig‘ining ichida
mcq.explanation: Sinish uchlari orasidagi ko‘prik hududi (2-sayt) endoxondral suyak hosil bo‘lishi bilan rivojlanadi va suyak taraqqiyotini eslatadi. Periostdagi intramembranoz va ilikdagi intramedullyar suyak hosil bo‘lishi tog‘ay bosqichisiz kechadi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

mcq.question: Kallusning kislorod kam va mexanik zo‘riqish yuqori bo‘lgan qismida mezenximal progenitorlar qaysi yo‘nalishda differensiatsiyalanadi?
options: Osteogen yo‘nalishda, kortikal yuzada intramembranoz suyak hosil qiladi
Adipogen yo‘nalishda, kallus ichida yog‘ to‘qimasi hosil qiladi
Miogen yo‘nalishda, kallus ichida mushak tolalari hosil qiladi
Xondrogen yo‘nalishda, sinishni mustahkamlovchi yumshoq kallus hosil qiladi
mcq.explanation: Kislorodga boy va mexanik barqaror joylarda MSC lar osteogen yo‘nalishni tanlaydi. Gipoksik yoki mexanik zo‘riqqan sharoitda esa xondrogen dastur ishga tushib, sinishni barqarorlashtiruvchi tog‘aysimon yumshoq kallus hosil bo‘ladi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

mcq.question: Sinishdan keyin kallusga yangi kapillyarlar kirib, qon bilan ta’minlanish va oksigenatsiya tiklandi. HIF parchalanishi natijasida VEGF ifodasi qanday o‘zgaradi?
options: Pasayadi, tomir novdalanishi susayib, tomirlar yetila boshlaydi
Keskin oshadi, tomir novdalanishi yanada kuchayib davom etadi
O‘zgarmaydi, chunki HIF kallusda VEGF ifodasini boshqarmaydi
Faqat osteoblastlarda oshadi, endoteliy hujayralarida o‘zgarmaydi
mcq.explanation: Sinishdan keyingi gipoksiya HIF-1α ni barqarorlashtiradi va u VEGF ni induksiya qiladi. Perfuziya tiklanganda HIF parchalanadi, VEGF ifodasi pasayadi, novdalanish susayib tomirlar yetiladi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

mcq.question: Eksperimentda qattiq kallusda mineralizatsiya to‘xtab qoldi. Mineralizatsiya davom etishi uchun ifodasi pasayishi shart bo‘lgan BMP ingibitori qaysi?
mcq.explanation: 3-fazada noggin, ya’ni BMP ning osteoblast differensiatsiyasini rag‘batlantirishini to‘suvchi ingibitor, ifodasining pasayishi mineralizatsiya davom etishi uchun zarur. Osteopontin va osteokalsin osteoblast belgilari, Runx2 esa osteoblastogenezni boshqaradigan omil.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

mcq.question: Remodellanish davrida osteoblastlar osteoprotegerin (OPG) sekretsiyasini oshirdi. Bu osteoklastlar hosil bo‘lishiga qanday ta’sir qiladi?
options: RANKL ni bog‘lab ushlab, osteoklastogenezni cheklaydi
RANK retseptorini ko‘paytirib, suyak resorbsiyasini oshiradi
mcq.explanation: OPG yolg‘on retseptor sifatida RANKL ni bog‘lab, uning osteoklast prekursorlaridagi RANK ga ulanishiga yo‘l qo‘ymaydi va osteoklastogenezni cheklaydi. RANKL/OPG nisbati almashinuv yo‘nalishini belgilaydi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

mcq.question: Remodellanish bosqichida vaqtincha hosil bo‘lgan dag‘al tolali suyak asta-sekin qanday suyak turi bilan almashtiriladi?
mcq.explanation: Remodellanish sinish bitishining eng uzoq va oxirgi bosqichi bo‘lib, unda vaqtincha dag‘al tolali suyak rezorbsiya va hosil bo‘lish sikllari orqali yetuk plastinkasimon suyak bilan almashadi. Granulyatsion to‘qima va tog‘aysimon kallus esa avvalgi bosqichlarga xos.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

mcq.question: Bemor qandli diabet bilan og‘rigan va chekadi. Sinish joyida kallus kichik, kam minerallashgan. Ikkala omilga xos umumiy mexanizm qaysi?
options: Kallusning qon bilan ta’minlanishi va tomirlanishi pasayadi
Xondrotsitlar kallusda haddan tashqari ko‘payib ketadi
Gematoma ortiqcha ivib, kallusni qoplab oladi
mcq.explanation: Jadvalga ko‘ra diabetda kallus kam tomirlangan, kichik va kam minerallashgan, VEGF kamayadi va mikrotomir disfunksiyasi bo‘ladi. Chekishda kallus perfuziyasi va tomirlanishi kamayadi, osteoangiogen bog‘lanish buziladi. Umumiy jihat: tomir ta’minotining yomonlashuvi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

mcq.question: Rentgenda kallus mo‘l, lekin sinish uchlari o‘rtasida ko‘prik yo‘q, uchlar qimirlaydi. Bu qaysi turdagi nobitishga mos keladi?
options: Atrofik nobitishga, ya’ni kallus juda kam
mcq.explanation: Gipertrofik nobitishda kallus ko‘p, lekin ko‘prik yo‘q. Bu biologik faollik saqlanganini, ammo mexanik barqarorlik yetarli emasligini ko‘rsatadi. Atrofik turda kallus kam va tomirlanish yomon bo‘ladi.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

mcq.question: Talaba remodellanish bosqichidagi bemorga osteoklast faolligini erta va to‘liq so‘ndiruvchi standart dori buyurmoqchi. Bunda asosiy biologik xavf nima?
options: Gematoma tezroq so‘rilib, yallig‘lanish bosqichi qisqaradi
Yumshoq kallus darrov qattiq kallusga aylanib ketadi
Kallusni qayta qurish uchun zarur rezorbsiya jarayonlari yo‘qoladi
Periost o‘zak hujayralari soni keskin oshib ketadi
mcq.explanation: Osteoklastlar kallusni qayta shakllantirishda va suyak hosil bo‘lishini bog‘lashda muhim. Standart dorilar osteoklastni bostirib, to‘qima qayta qurilishi uchun kerakli rezorbtiv va signal jarayonlarini ham yo‘qotadi. Bu to‘qima suyagining plastinkasimon suyakka aylanishini buzishi mumkin.

source.author: Flurina Staubli va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: from molecular and cellular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies, Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy

mcq.question: Abaloparatid teriparatidga nisbatan PTH retseptorining qaysi konformatsiyasiga selektivroq bog‘lanadi?
mcq.explanation: Abaloparatid RG shakliga R° shakliga nisbatan yuqori selektivlik ko‘rsatadi. RG shakli tezroq va kamroq davomli signal beradi, bu esa suyakda anabolik ta’sirni kuchli, katabolik ta’sirni kuchsizroq qiladi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.
source.title: Fracture healing: cellular mechanisms and impact of parathyroid hormone and its analogs, Frontiers in Endocrinology

mcq.question: Tajribada uzun suyak sinishida periostning ichki kambial qavati zararlandi. Qaysi hujayralar manbasi eng ko‘p zarar ko‘radi?
options: Periostning kambial qavatidagi o‘zak hujayralar zarar ko‘radi
Faqat Pax7 musbat mushak sun’iy yo‘ldosh hujayralari yo‘qoladi
Qon plazmasidagi eritrotsitlar kallus manbai sifatida yo‘qoladi
Faqat o‘sish plastinkasidagi xondrotsitlar manbasi yo‘qoladi
mcq.explanation: Periost kambial qavatidagi o‘zak hujayralar uzun suyak sinishida kallus hujayralarining asosiy manbai hisoblanadi. Ular davolashda suyak iligi o‘zak hujayralaridan ustun turadi. Pax7 musbat mushak sun’iy yo‘ldosh hujayralari esa sinish bitishida rol o‘ynamaydi.

source.author: Bikle D va boshq.

extras.text: Eslab qolish usuli: suyak bitishining 4 bosqichi “Q-Q-Q-Q”: Qon quyilishi (gematoma va yallig‘lanish), Qurilish boshlanishi (qon tomir va xaryashsimon yumshoq kallus), Qotish (qattiq kallus), Qayta qurish (remodellash). Taxminiy davomiyligi: 1-bosqich ~5 kun, 2-bosqich ~5 kun, 3-bosqich bir necha hafta, 4-bosqich oylardan yillargacha. Bosqichlar bir-birini qoplaydi.

extras.text: Qiziqarli fakt: uzun suyakda yangi suyak 3 joyda hosil bo‘ladi: periost yuzasida (intramembranoz), singan uchlar orasida (endoxondral) va ilik ichida (intramedullyar). Ilik ichidagi joy ko‘pincha e’tibordan chetda qolgan. Sababi: tajribada ilik bo‘shlig‘iga qo‘yilgan mix (pin) shu bo‘shliqni to‘ldirib, u yerda yangi suyak hosil bo‘lishiga yo‘l qo‘ymaydi.

extras.text: Hodisa tahlili: kallus katta, lekin singan uchlar ko‘prik hosil qilmagan. Bu gipertrofik nobitishga xos holat. Biologik faollik saqlangan, ammo mexanik barqarorlik yetarli emas. Atrofik shaklda esa kallus kam, qon tomirlar va hujayra faolligi susaygan. Muhim farq: gipertrofik nobitish ≠ atrofik nobitish, shuning uchun davo yondashuvi ham farq qiladi.

extras.text: Eslab qolish qoidasi: hujayra taqdirini kislorod va mexanik barqarorlik hal qiladi. Kislorodga boy va barqaror joyda MSC (mezenximal stromal/ildiz hujayra) bevosita suyak hosil qiladi (intramembranoz). Gipoksik yoki mexanik zo‘riqqan joyda esa xaryashsimon yumshoq kallus hosil qiladi. Xaryashsimon hujayralarning bir qismi keyinchalik osteoblastga aylanishi mumkin.

extras.text: Klinik ahamiyatli fakt: radiografik bitish har doim to‘liq mexanik tiklanishni bildirmaydi. Suyak birikkan ko‘rinsa ham, uning mineral zichligi past yoki mikroarxitekturasi buzilgan, mustahkamligi kamaygan bo‘lishi mumkin. Shuning uchun faqat rentgen suratiga qarab “to‘liq tuzaldi” deyish xavfli bo‘lishi mumkin.
